title: A subject whose movement mode is HOLD still takes a step toward its stored target
summary: A hold holds: typed waits clear the stored target in the update that sets HOLD, the movement check honours a pending clear, HOLD ends at the next walk decision or with a collapse's sleep; stage 1 and 2 measured, Tier 2 read 1 FED of 5, landed with the cornered-hold follow-up filed (#715 6906654192).
